column2: It seems you have remembered a little, at least!!
$$メタトロン$$ was the old name Lord $$メフィスト$$ used while serving $$ゴッド$$...
Which means you are the ruler of this $$世界$$...
the true reincarnation of Lord $$メフィスト・フェレス$$!
When you think about it, it is only natural that you would be drawn to our daughter...
the child born of the $$大天使$$ Lord $$メフィスト$$ and me...
When you think about it, it is only natural that you would be drawn to our son...
the child born of the $$大天使$$ Lord $$メフィスト$$ and me...
has no such thing as sex from the beginning, you know!?
To recover the complete $$記憶$$ of when you were Lord $$メフィスト$$...
